_comment_log_expdata: log_expdata defaults to false -- results print to console but are NOT saved. Pass --override log_expdata=true to persist to results.db.
_comment_checkpoint_dir: For load_model_from=checkpoint, checkpoint.checkpoint_dir must be the FULL path used verbatim (e.g. 'model_checkpoints/ectiednet_imagenet1k_depth4'), not the bare run name train configs use -- setup_checkpoint_dir() prepends 'model_checkpoints/' on the train side, load_model() does not re-add it on the eval side.
